term.label: polymorphic_pseudogene_with_retained_intron

definition.text: A polymorphic pseudogene in the reference genome, containing a retained intron, known to be intact in the genomes of other individuals of the same species. The annotation process has confirmed that the pseudogenisation event is not a genomic sequencing error.

comments: Term added as part of collaboration with Gencode, adding biotypes used in annotation.
